text: OVERDOSAGE: In all cases of suspected overdose, immediately call your regional poison center and/or contact a physician immediately. The stomach should be emptied promptly by lavage or induction of emesis with syrup of ipecac. The installation of activated charcoal into he stomach also should be considered. The treatment of overdose is essentially sypmptomatic and supportive. If respiratory depression is present treat promptly with oxygen and/or mechanical support of ventilation. If convulsions or marked CNS excitement occurs, only short-acting benzodiazepine-type drugs should be used.
